name: ANSI/IEEE Three-position disconnector form
aliases: IEEE Two Way Disconnect with 3 Positions
summary: IEEE-library form of three-position disconnector: a three-position disconnector selects between two paths and an intermediate position.
description: This reference locates three-position disconnector in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented disconnect 1 pole family. A three-position disconnector selects between two paths and an intermediate position. Switchgear schematics must define each position and any linked earth or isolation function explicitly. The public library uses HDS11Q89 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Use the surrounding circuit labels and the project legend to identify the intended operating condition and connection. Carry the same device reference into the schedule or equipment document so the symbol can be reconciled with its real terminals, function and operating limits.

The middle position must be labelled rather than assumed to be open or earthed. Three positions describe available states; they do not imply that every transition can occur under load. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
